title: Deep Visibility / PowerQuery Hunt Template
description: A single MITRE-tagged Deep Visibility hunt template (Phase 2, Milestone 5). Per the powerquery tool's own documentation (see data/knowledge/sentinelone/mcp_tools.md), the query string should generally originate from purple_ai(natural language) rather than being hand-composed -- a template here records the natural-language prompt and/or the resulting validated PowerQuery string.

hunt_pattern.description: Which hunt pattern this template covers. The first six are the brief's original core patterns; impact/discovery/defense_evasion were added post-Phase-2 when real-world query examples (ransomware file-encryption, recon commands, security-tooling tampering) didn't map to any of the original six -- extending the enum rather than mis-tagging a genuinely different MITRE tactic into an ill-fitting bucket.

mitre.description: MITRE ATT&CK tactic/technique tags for this template.

query_source.description: How this template's PowerQuery string was produced.

natural_language_prompt.description: The prompt given to purple_ai() to generate this template's query, per the tool's own recommended workflow.

resulting_query.description: The exact PowerQuery string purple_ai() returned and that was subsequently validated -- run exactly as generated, per the tool's own instructions against modifying it.

default_window.description: Mandatory default time window for this template, e.g. 'PT24H' (ISO 8601 duration). Every DV query must be windowed.

result_cap.description: Mandatory result cap for this template's query.

false_positives_observed.description: Known false-positive patterns recorded during validation on the live tenant.

status.description: Only 'stable' templates run without analyst confirmation.

storyline_pivot.description: True if this template implements the storyline pivot procedure (read StorylineId from an alert, sweep it across endpoints in Deep Visibility, assemble the chain with MITRE tags).
